purpose: Vector task allocation, redundancy control, coalition formation, error triangulation.

geometry_layers.concave: exploration: seek missing hypotheses and gaps
geometry_layers.plane: baseline: independent replication and neutral comparison
geometry_layers.stratospheric: meta-layer: cross-domain synthesis and escalation only when evidence justifies it

mechanisms.vector_showroom: publish compact capability vectors for farms/tasks
mechanisms.vector_distributor: assign tasks by domain/method/evidence needs and diversity
mechanisms.redundancy_budget: retain deliberate independent replication; suppress useless duplicate work
mechanisms.collapse_vector: merge equivalent task branches only after provenance/independence check
mechanisms.scaling_scan: estimate whether adding farms adds method/data diversity rather than headcount only
mechanisms.micro_impulse: small targeted challenge injected to break coalition lock-in
mechanisms.error_triangulation: compare >=3 methodologically distinct paths; disagreement remains explicit

hyperion_bridge.agora_role: concave exploration and blind alternative generation
hyperion_bridge.blind_branch_policy: retain independent branches without R0 when requested
